why: A pill pasted from one composer part into the next and renamed, as the usage and context-window pills were (the baseline's codex-usage-pill and context-window-dot). A design-system meter pasted into the app, so the copy goes unreported if .jscpd.json stops reading packages/ui/src (MAR-3610). Runs with the repo's own .jscpd.json, so it goes silent if minTokens is ever raised past a pasted pill.
